segments.topic: Matt Damon gets lost in cinematic worlds
segments.source_text: Matt Damon reflects on becoming completely absorbed in films, mentioning Interstellar, The Martian, Saving Private Ryan, and Odyssey while describing the pride he feels in those cinematic experiences.

segments.topic: Matt Damon freezes at extreme heights in Dubai
segments.source_text: Matt Damon explains that despite performing dangerous stunts, he discovered a fear of heights during a 2004 Dubai helicopter-pad experience with his wife, when the altitude made him freeze.
